topics.title: Mindfulness as a core meta-skill
topics.scope: Why mindfulness is the base development skill: a real-time feedback loop on automatic patterns, levels of mindfulness in daily life, well-being as a trainable skill, and its limits (shadow, dissociation, mainstream hype).

topics.title: Meditation practice: how to start and keep going
topics.scope: Practical how-to of meditation: beginner goals, working with mind-wandering through positive reinforcement, pleasant sensations, consistency, short frequent practices, and fixing a stuck practice.

topics.title: Metta, compassion and the four immeasurables
topics.scope: Heart practices: why and how to do Metta and self-compassion, adapting phrases, the four immeasurables, and using compassion with pain, hatred and rejection.

topics.title: Retreats and the deeper contemplative path
topics.scope: Going deeper: retreats and vipassana, shamatha, tantra, jhanas and cessation, prerequisites and risks of advanced practice, right motivation, and telling dissociation from witnessing.

topics.title: Impermanence, suffering and meeting experience
topics.scope: Contemplative views on suffering, fear, death and impermanence: pain times resistance, Tift's life as process not problem, Stoic control, memento mori, grief and resting in presence.

topics.title: Buddhist teachers, lineages and contemplative centres
topics.scope: Profiles and lessons of teachers and places that shaped the author's path: Trungpa, Wallace, Tsoknyi Rinpoche, Thich Nhat Hanh, Thurman, Shinzen Young, Kopan, Boulder, Crestone.

topics.title: Trauma and the nervous system: foundations
topics.scope: What trauma is and how it changes brain and body; window of tolerance, vagal tone, fight/freeze responses, why regulation precedes thinking, and trauma healing paths (EMDR, long-term work).

topics.title: Self-regulation techniques for stress and anxiety
topics.scope: Concrete body-based practices to calm the nervous system: breathing patterns, EFT tapping, grounding, centering, somatic micro-practices, glimmers, and short resets for hyperactivation.

topics.title: Coping with anxiety, panic, depression and personal crisis
topics.scope: How to recognise and work with anxiety, panic and depression in crises (market crash, Covid, lockdown, permacrisis): checklists, action plans, support teams and fear practices.

topics.title: Qualities of mindful and compassionate leaders
topics.scope: What makes a conscious leader: Dalio and Potential Project qualities, compassion in hard decisions, vulnerability, adult communication, ego, presence over 'fix it' neurosis.

topics.title: Toxic leadership, power and workplace ethics
topics.scope: Abuse and toxic behavior by leaders, rank and power dynamics, directive management roots, workplace toxicity data and ethical alternatives.

topics.title: Team trust, feedback and conflict
topics.scope: Building trust and psychological safety, feedback rules, constructive conflict, perfectionism culture and team flow.

topics.title: Meetings and group facilitation
topics.scope: Good meeting rules and roles, leader as facilitator, brave space vs safe space, team workshops, year-end facilitation and setting group boundaries.

topics.title: Motivation, talent and hiring
topics.scope: Intrinsic motivation and self-determination theory, Hogan motivators and derailers, hiring for culture fit, and the shifting talent market.

topics.title: Conscious business and company purpose
topics.scope: Conscious capitalism, purpose and values beyond profit, the myth that only measurable things matter, and anchoring a company in inner truth.

topics.title: Corporate culture change
topics.scope: How companies change culture: organizational grooves, types of companies, diversity and inclusion, change leadership, corporate retreats and stages of employee-care culture.

topics.title: Employee wellbeing and workplace mental health
topics.scope: Data and practice on workplace stress, burnout and mental health: surveys, resilience programs, quiet quitting, performance reviews, ESG and trauma-informed workplaces.

topics.title: Supporting teams through crisis
topics.scope: Managing team state in crises (Belarus, war, mobilization): productivity drops, Regulate-Relate-Reason, at-risk groups, support formats and leaders' new role in team state.

topics.title: Self-management and new organization models
topics.scope: Teal organizations, deep democracy, mechanistic vs organic companies, managing by context, transference in self-organization and Sociocracy 3.0.

topics.title: Founder lessons from building a meaning-driven company
topics.scope: Deep mind's origin, year reviews, failures and post-mortems, generative entrepreneurship, delegation, community as product and founder fear and burnout.

topics.title: Theory U, presencing and co-sensing
topics.scope: Scharmer's Theory U: open mind, heart and will, presencing, case clinics, Social Presencing Theater and The Village, and its application in companies, retreats and communities.

topics.title: Burnout: causes, warning signs and prevention
topics.scope: Burnout as chronic stress with systemic roots: personal stories, warning signs, exercise and habits during burnout, talking to your boss, and frameworks like ReST.

topics.title: Rest and recovery: vacations, year-end and weekends
topics.scope: How to really rest: types of rest, why year-end crunch backfires, vacation and retreat design, weekends, letting go instead of rest-as-project.

topics.title: Measuring and managing stress load
topics.scope: Why people misjudge their stress, HRV and stress-load measurement, chronic false adaptation, state management as a skill and closing open loops.

topics.title: Critique of achievement and productivity culture
topics.scope: Byung-Chul Han's burnout society, grind and hustle myths, 'achievism' in crisis, achieving from trauma vs presence, and why slowing down is hard.

topics.title: Emotional skills: accepting, naming and working with emotions
topics.scope: Emotional intelligence in practice: accepting and naming emotions, emotions in decisions, anger, shame, guilt vs regret, cultivating constructive emotions, oversharing and three levels of treating emotions.

topics.title: Ego, narcissism and authenticity
topics.scope: Healthy vs inflated ego, narcissism in the attention economy, cynicism and idealism, vulnerability, and real vs performative authenticity.

topics.title: Meaning, purpose and life direction
topics.scope: Finding purpose and meaning: want vs must motivation, agency and authorship, against nihilism, values and direction instead of yearly goals, and transcendent tasks.

topics.title: Vertical development and the integral approach
topics.scope: Adult development (Kegan, Torbert, spiral dynamics) and Wilber's integral map: stages, boosters of vertical growth, integral life practice and inner work across the lifespan.

topics.title: Relationships, family systems and parenting
topics.scope: Conscious partnership, family loyalty systems and separation, parenting and children's stress, supporting loved ones, and relationships as the indicator of inner growth.

topics.title: Masculinity, gender and leadership
topics.scope: Fear and compensation in men's psychology (Hollis), hegemonic vs mature masculinity, men's coping, and feminine qualities and diversity in leadership.

topics.title: Community, belonging and loneliness
topics.scope: Why social isolation harms, the value of small trusted communities, and how narcissistic or alpha-driven communities differ from honest, egalitarian ones.

topics.title: Willpower, self-control and habits: what the evidence says
topics.scope: The failed replication of ego depletion ('willpower is a muscle'), and why people with high self-control rely on habits and fewer temptations rather than willpower; skepticism toward attractive scientific explanations.

topics.title: Relating to the future: images of the future, future self and mature progress
topics.scope: Why the future feels darker and how to relate to it: Polak's image of the future and four attitudes, Three Horizons, MIT 'Future You' and Hershfield's future self, and Schmachtenberger's questions for mature vs immature progress.

topics.title: Psychotherapy: methods, choosing and getting results
topics.scope: How therapy works and how to get more from it: therapeutic alliance, evidence debates, IFS, Focusing, Hoffman, personality types, psychedelic therapy, and AI vs human therapists.

topics.title: Ethics and safety in inner work: choosing teachers and practitioners
topics.scope: Trauma-informed ethics, retraumatization risks, red flags of pseudo-gurus and cults, operational language vs 'energy', facilitator duty of care, and how to choose specialists.

topics.title: Spiritual materialism and pitfalls on the inner path
topics.scope: Consumer and collecting approaches to self-development, intensity bias, spiritual bypassing and 'resort consciousness', and why motivation, repetition and simplicity matter.

topics.title: Attention, focus and information overload
topics.scope: Attention deficit and overload, multitasking costs, focus principles, mind-wandering data, ADHD vs dysregulation, and information-management systems like FAST.

topics.title: Digital detox and healthy screen habits
topics.scope: Screens as regulator and addiction: information detox checklists, social-media breaks, morning/evening phone rules, screen apnea, persuasive design and mindful craving work.

topics.title: Neurodiversity: ADHD, autism and masking
topics.scope: Why no one fits the 'average' norm (Daniels' cockpit study) and what neurodiversity means in practice: autism, ADHD, masking, support at work and AI prompts for self-support.

topics.title: Remote, hybrid and the future of work
topics.scope: Remote and hybrid work, return to office, BANI and post-covid forecasts, freelance and solo-preneurship, flexible schedules and future employee demands.

topics.title: AI and the human transition
topics.scope: Psychology of the AI era: AI anxiety and adoption, AI-native professionals, AI in therapy and mindfulness, human intelligences AI cannot replace, meaning of work.

topics.title: Collective trauma, propaganda and society
topics.scope: How collective trauma and wounded narcissism sustain propaganda and violence in Russia, attachment to state power, chosen trauma, and healing through communities.

topics.title: Keeping an inner stance through war and repression
topics.scope: Personal practice and ethics in wartime: inner supports, agency, avoiding numbness and normalization of violence, moral injury and staying humane.

topics.title: Politics, power and authoritarianism
topics.scope: Essays on authoritarian leadership, Belarus protests, values shifts, why people wage war, populism and the narrative of personal agency in social change.

topics.title: Emigration and relocation psychology
topics.scope: Psychology of the 2022 emigration: life split, grief, separation-individuation, the four groups of the community and integration into new cultures.

topics.title: Freedom, capitalism and contemporary culture
topics.scope: Critiques of consumption and attention capitalism, freedom (Fromm, Scott, Foucault), culture wars, postmodern values and cultural reflections from travel.

topics.title: Public ethics, abuse scandals and media responsibility
topics.scope: Ethics in the public sphere: abuse scandals, victim-blaming, power and narcissism, responsibility of public figures and bloggers, imitation of expertise.

topics.title: Sleep, sleep debt and caffeine
topics.scope: Sleep as the basis of resilience: evening routines, sleep debt, light and circadian rhythm, magnesium baths, quitting caffeine and insomnia as an anxiety-control loop.

topics.title: Embodiment and body practices
topics.scope: Why the body matters for mental health and organizations: posture, exercise in burnout, yoga and TRE, hiking and dance as embodiment, and embodiment as a basic need.

topics.title: Supplements and recovery protocols
topics.scope: Protocols for brain fog, high load and travel: anti-inflammatory nutrition, supplements and adaptogens, MCT/ghee, ergonomic setup, with safety caveats.

topics.title: Wellness industry, gadgets and trends
topics.scope: Mental-health investment, luxury wellness, neurofeedback and wearables, recovery tech, and wellness trend forecasts with a critique of biohacking reductionism.
